1.text: Isabato ishize, Mariya Magadalena na Mariya nyina wa Yakobo na Salome, bagura ibihumura neza ngo bajye kubimusīga.

2.text: Nuko mu museke ku wa mbere w'iminsi irindwi baragenda, bagera ku gituro izuba rirashe.

3.text: Barabazanya bati “Ni nde uri butubirindurire cya gitare kiri ku munwa w'igituro?”

4.text: Ariko bararamye babona igitare kibirunduriwe hirya, nubwo cyari kinini cyane.

5.text: Binjiye mu gituro babona umusore wicaye mu ruhande rw'iburyo wambaye umwenda wera, baratangara cyane.

6.text: Arababwira ati “Mwitangara. Nzi yuko mushaka Yesu w'i Nazareti wabambwe, ariko yazutse ntari hano, dore aho bari baramushyize.

7.text: Nimugende mubwire abigishwa be na Petero muti ‘Arababanziriza kujya i Galilaya, iyo ni ho muzamubonera nk'uko yababwiye.’ ”

8.text: Bava mu gituro batangara bahinda umushyitsi, nuko barahunga. Ariko ntibagira umuntu babibwira, kuko bari batinye.

9.text: Nuko amaze kuzuka mu museke ku wa mbere w'iminsi irindwi, abanza kubonekera Mariya Magadalena, uwo yirukanyemo abadayimoni barindwi.

10.text: Uwo aragenda abibwira ababanaga na we, asanga baganya barira bari mu majune.

11.text: Na bo bumvise yuko ari muzima abonywe na we, ntibabyemera.

12.text: Hanyuma y'ibyo Yesu abonekera babiri muri bo afite indi shusho, bagenda bajya imusozi.

13.text: Na bo basubirayo babibwira ba bandi, nyamara ntibabemerera na bo.

14.text: Ubwa nyuma abonekera abigishwa be cumi n'umwe bicaye bafungura, abagaya ku bwo kutizera kwabo no kunangirwa kw'imitima kwabo, kuko batemereye abamubonye amaze kuzuka.

15.text: Arababwira ati “Mujye mu bihugu byose, mwigishe abaremwe bose ubutumwa bwiza.

16.text: Uwizera akabatizwa azakizwa, ariko utizera azacirwaho iteka.

17.text: Kandi ibimenyetso bizagumana n'abizera ngibi: bazirukana abadayimoni mu izina ryanjye, bazavuga indimi nshya,

18.text: bazafata inzoka, kandi nibanywa ikintu cyica nta cyo kizabatwara na hato, bazarambika ibiganza ku barwayi bakire.”

19.text: Nuko Umwami Yesu amaze kuvugana na bo, ajyanwa mu ijuru yicara iburyo bw'Imana.

20.text: Abo barasohoka bigisha hose, Umwami Yesu ari kumwe na bo abafasha, akomeresha ijambo rye ibimenyetso byagendanaga na ryo.]
